t: Round Robin is only available on Extractor Mode.$(br2)Round robin instructs an extractor to evenly distribute items among multiple inserters.$(br2)There are three modes available:$(br)1. False$(br)2. True$(br)3. Enforced
轮询调度仅在提取模式可用。$(br2)轮询调度能让提取卡将取出的物品、流体和能量平均分配至多个输入卡。$(br2)共有三种可用模式：$(br)1. 否$(br)2. 是$(br)3. 强制

When set to $(l)false$(), round robin is disabled, and the $(l:laserio:priority)priority$(/l) system is followed. The first inventory will fill entirely before objects are sent to the second inventory.$(br2)When set to $(l)true$(), items will be sent to chests in priority order, and evenly distributed.$(br2)If there are 3 chests in a network, the first set of items will go to the first chest, the 2nd set to the 2nd chest, etc.
设置为$(l)否$()时，会禁用轮询调度功能，转而使用$(l:laserio:priority)优先级$(/l)系统：第一顺位存储空间填满后才会输出至第二顺位。$(br2)设置为$(l)是$()时，物品会根据优先级依次存入个箱子，平均分配。$(br2)若在网络内有 3 个箱子，第一组物品会存入第一顺位的箱子，第二组会存入第二顺位，如此循环。

When set to $(l)enforced$(), the same rules as 'true' are followed. However, if one of the destinations becomes full, the extractor will stop operating until it becomes available again.$(br2)Note: Chunk Unloading may cause a change to round robin mechanics, especially if some nodes are unloaded when others are not.
设置为$(l)强制$()时，大部分规则与“是”模式相同。但如果某存储空间被填满，提取卡便会停止运行，直到该存储空间可再次存入物品。$(br2)注意：区块卸载可能会导致轮询调度机制出现变动，尤其是在部分节点被卸载的情况下。
